purpose: Public matched-control delivery; no baseline repair performance has been measured.

none.materialization: Do not supply --experience; no learned artifact is required.

generic.authorship: Original five requirements supplied by Matthew Shell; the first item was revised by the agent and explicitly approved by the contributor to cover both prediction goals. The other four retain the contributor wording.
generic.directory_name_note: The historical draft suffix does not mean the approved wording is unresolved.
generic.primary_score: For each condition, min(unseen-unit verified repair rate, future-observation verified repair rate).
generic.freeze: Use these exact bytes for generic control; freeze all final settings before reserved evaluation.

fixed_execution.matching: The same model, instructions, tools, loader and budgets for every condition. All arms of each case use the same preassigned worker.

boundary: Manifest/provenance files are outside the supplied experience directory. The accumulated experience package is produced later from verified source/development repairs, not delivered as a pre-existing result.
